scopeNotes.en: Permanent national and departmental lists are reconciled name by name. Named temporary varieties are distinguished from unprofiled experimental accessions. Section c refers to Geneva cross-border provisions and is not an enumerated list. National classification does not confer AOC eligibility or establish commercial acreage.
scopeNotes.zh: 全国及限定省份的固定分类逐名核对；有独立档案的临时分类与尚未建档的试验编号分列。第 c 项为 Genève 跨境条款，不是逐名品种表。全国分类不等于 AOC 许可，也不证明商业种植面积。
